name: Version 3.9.9
body:
## What's Changed
* Fixed comma character in macos resolution by @ImJustToNy in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/657
* Fix proxmox distro detection by @M0NsTeRRR in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/655
* Fix total disk size for WSL based distros by @Roguyt in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/661
* Fixes for macOS by @Albatrosicks in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/664
* fix tcsh shell detection by looking at /proc/$PPID/exe by @cruvolo in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/668
* fix e16 theme detection by @cruvolo in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/667
* add generic support for aarch64 CPUs by @jda in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/673
* Drauger OS - smaller logo by @Batcastle in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/674
* draugeros ditributive by @sol4ik in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/651
* Improve package counting for NixOS by @KamilaBorowska in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/678
* Add support to macOS Big Sur on Intel CPUs by @KanzakiRanko1 in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/681
* [ Using a flag ] allow adding custom lines of text to the screenfetch output by @takattila in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/707
* Detect CentOS Stream correctly by @Jacksonzwang in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/702
* Add a logo of UOS, the commercial version of Deepin by @hubenchang0515 in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/699
* adding support for Arch Linux 32 by @zeichenreihe in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/679
* Added AlterLinux logo by @Hayao0819 in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/683
* Fix for Issue 704(Languages with longer words for memory) by @dalto8 in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/708
* Fix awesomewm theme detection by @necauqua in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/713
* Add TeArch Linux. by @efectn in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/719
* New ASCII logo for Fedora by @L1kwidus in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/718
* Remove trailing whitespace characters by @hginzel in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/720
* SulinOS Logo by @sulincix in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/658
* Detect Powershell version. by @PJB3005 in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/665
* ignore devtmpfs in disk space calculations by @jda in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/737
* Fix for grep warning about stray \ by @dino- in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/755
* Use non-experimental Nix CLI by @ncfavier in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/757
* Replace grep with --productVersion and --buildVersion option when calling sw_vers by @irliao in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/765
* Fix Homebrew package count on macOS by @carlosramosgonz in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/772
* Detect which awk to use by @drinkcat in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/773
* Add Rocky Linux Distro support by @toti787 in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/726
* Update requirements list in the documentation by @ogarcia in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/776
* Fix syntax error in macOS by @zealoussnow in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/780
* AlmaLinux Support by @vndroid in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/781
* I add the Quirinux distribution, based on Debian. by @charliemartinez in https://github.com/KittyKatt/screenFetch/pull/785
